ctx.x: His wife, actually, is who that is.

His wife, yeah. But he was also a very sensitive person. As a result he was very kind and gentle to everybody else. I never heard him raise his voice or anything like that. But toward the end, he not only drank himself to death. He was also – used heroin. I’m not so sure. Yeah, the heroin was there too. He used a lot of things. I think he might have been, if not clinically depressed, often depressed.

But what I’m trying to understand is the fact that these three great artists did drink themselves to death. Is it because they were black? I mean, it’s all these things.
